description: List supported InterPro database slugs, entry types, accession and PDB identifier patterns, common taxon IDs, or current release information.

topic.description: Reference topic; release retrieves current upstream metadata.

name: interpro_list_reference

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_shape_invalid`: Upstream JSON or response structure is incompatible. `upstream_response_too_large`: An upstream response exceeds 4 MiB. `release_changed`: Release metadata and count responses advertise different versions. `upstream_rejected`: InterPro returns an unhandled redirect or client rejection. `upstream_unavailable`: InterPro has a network or server failure; HTTP 501 is not retryable. `upstream_timeout`: InterPro returns HTTP 408/504 or an attempt exceeds its deadline. `upstream_rate_limited`: InterPro returns HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: Applicable reference vocabulary; empty for release.

accessionPattern.description: Accession routing pattern, case-insensitive except where the item description says otherwise.

example.description: Example accession spelling; assignment is not guaranteed.

release.description: Current live release metadata when requested.
